contents.text: 恭喜你成功完成市集挖寶(2)！

野灣是誰？2016年，主要發起人之一綦孟柔接獲台東一隻山羌被遊蕩犬隻攻擊的案件，為了將山羌從台東運送到屏東救援，耗費整天的時間及人力，最終接到山羌的時候已經錯失了救援的機會，只能讓牠在深深的麻醉中永遠睡去。如此的案例讓綦孟柔深思：「我們還能夠為這些動物做些什麼？」，想著想著…突然一念閃過，轉頭跟助理說：「我們去東部蓋救傷中心吧？」沒想到助理竟爽快地回答說：「走啊！」。2016年年末，野灣WildOne就此誕生。野灣由八位野生動物工作者發起，包含三名臨床獸醫師、一名病理獸醫師、兩名保育復健員、以及兩名研究員。籌備初期歷經各種磨合與挑戰，但秉著對保育之路的堅定決心，最終仍找到彼此的默契，堅定繼續向理想邁進。野灣順利於2017年立案通過，並於2018年申請登記為社團法人；成立至今，陸續已有各領域的夥伴加入我們，包含獸醫影像顧問、傳媒顧問等領域志工共同協助臺灣的保育工作。野灣於2019年承租台糖池上牧野渡假村中的閒置建物，改建成適合野生動物醫療及復健的場域，並於2020年8月15日正式啟用，至今已救援超過1950隻野生動物，其中包含保育類台灣黑熊、長鬃山羊、穿山甲等珍貴物種。我們持續與公部門及私人企業合作，期待將保育觀念普及，讓更多有志一同的夥伴一同加入！

What is WildOne? WildOne is an organization founded in 2016. One of its main initiators, Chi Meng-Jou, encountered a case in Taitung involving a barking deer that had been attacked by stray dogs. Transporting the animal from Taitung to Pingtung for rescue took an entire day and significant manpower. By the time they received the deer, the critical window for treatment had already passed, and they could only let it pass away peacefully under deep anesthesia. This incident led Chi Meng-Jou to reflect: “What more can we do for these animals?” Then, an idea suddenly came to her. She turned to her assistant and said, “Let’s build a wildlife rescue center in eastern Taiwan.” To her surprise, the assistant readily replied, “Let’s do it!” Thus, WildOne was born at the end of 2016. WildOne was initiated by eight wildlife professionals, including three clinical veterinarians, one veterinary pathologist, two wildlife rehabilitators, and two researchers. In its early stages, the team faced various challenges and adjustments, but with a shared commitment to conservation, they gradually built strong teamwork and continued moving toward their vision. WildOne was officially registered in 2017 and became an incorporated association in 2018. Since its founding, professionals from various fields have joined, including veterinary imaging consultants and media advisors, all contributing to wildlife conservation efforts in Taiwan. In 2019, WildOne leased an unused facility at the Taisugar Chishang Ranch Resort and transformed it into a space suitable for wildlife medical care and rehabilitation. The center officially opened on August 15, 2020. To date, it has rescued more than 1,950 wild animals, including protected species such as the Formosan black bear, Formosan serow, and pangolin. WildOne continues to collaborate with government agencies and private enterprises, aiming to promote conservation awareness and invite more like-minded partners to join their mission.
